description: Create an organization membership in Zendesk by assigning a user to an organization. By default, the request marks the membership as the user's default organization; this can be changed.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for creating an organization membership.

default.description: Denotes whether this is the default organization membership for the user. If set to true, this membership will be the primary organization for the user. Defaults to true if not specified.
default.human_parameter_description: Whether this should be the user's default organization. When true, this becomes the primary organization for the user. Defaults to true.
default.title: Default

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization to assign the user to. Must be a non-null integer. Obtain from zendesk.get_all_zendesk_organizations or zendesk.get_zendesk_organization_BY_ID; do not guess or fabricate IDs.
organization_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the numeric ID of the organization to which the user should be assigned. You can find organization IDs by listing or searching organizations in Zendesk.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

user_id.description: The ID of the user to assign to the organization. Must be a non-null integer. Obtain from ZENDESK_LIST_USERS or ZENDESK_SEARCH_USERS; do not guess or fabricate IDs.
user_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the numeric ID of the user who should be assigned to the organization. You can find user IDs by listing or searching users in Zendesk.
user_id.title: User Id
